title: Stop These 3 Steering Mistakes While Parking
hook: Stop ruining your steering system now.

script.narration: Stop ruining your steering system now.
script.visual_search: close up of car steering wheel turning sharply

script.narration: First, never turn your steering wheel while the car is completely stopped. That causes massive wear on your tires and suspension joints. Second, stop holding the steering wheel at full lock when making sharp turns. Back off slightly to save your power steering pump from overheating. Third, never let the steering wheel snap back on its own after a tight turn. Always guide it smoothly.
